---
title: "Superstore Sales Dashboard"
author: "Reports"
format:
  dashboard:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)

orders <- read_csv(
  "../data/superstore_orders.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("\ufeff", "", .x, fixed = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(
    order_date = dmy(`Order Date`),
    ship_date = dmy(`Ship Date`),
    order_month = floor_date(order_date, "month"),
    order_year = year(order_date),
    profit_margin = if_else(Sales > 0, Profit / Sales, NA_real_),
    discount_band = case_when(
      Discount == 0 ~ "No discount",
      Discount <= 0.2 ~ "Up to 20%",
      Discount <= 0.4 ~ "21% to 40%",
      TRUE ~ "Above 40%"
    )
  )

kpis <- orders |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    orders = n_distinct(`Order ID`),
    customers = n_distinct(`Customer ID`),
    margin = profit / sales
  )

monthly <- orders |>
  group_by(order_month) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    orders = n_distinct(`Order ID`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category <- orders |>
  group_by(Category, `Sub-Category`) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantity = sum(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(margin = profit / sales)

region <- orders |>
  group_by(Region, Segment) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    orders = n_distinct(`Order ID`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

states <- orders |>
  group_by(`State/Province`, Region) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    orders = n_distinct(`Order ID`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(profit)

top_products <- orders |>
  group_by(`Product Name`, Category, `Sub-Category`) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantity = sum(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(sales)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

loss_products <- orders |>
  group_by(`Product Name`, Category, `Sub-Category`) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantity = sum(Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(profit) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

currency_short <- label_dollar(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())
```

```{css}
.value-box-title {  font-weight: 700;}
```

# Executive Summary

## Row

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(  title = "Sales",  value = currency_short(kpis$sales),
  icon = "cash-stack",  color = "primary")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(  title = "Profit",  value = currency_short(kpis$profit),  icon = "graph-up-arrow",  color = if (kpis$profit >= 0) "success" else "danger")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(  title = "Orders",  value = comma(kpis$orders),
  icon = "receipt",  color = "info")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(  title = "Profit margin",  value = percent(kpis$margin, accuracy = 0.1),  icon = "percent",  color = "warning")
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Monthly sales and profit"
#| fig-height: 5.5

monthly_long <- monthly |>  pivot_longer(c(sales, profit), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>  mutate(metric = recode(metric, sales = "Sales", profit = "Profit"))

p_monthly <- ggplot(monthly_long, aes(order_month, value, color = metric)) +  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +  geom_point(size = 1.7) +  scale_y_continuous(labels = currency_short) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sales" = "#2f6f9f", "Profit" = "#3f8f5f")) +  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p_monthly, tooltip = c("x", "y", "color"))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Sales and profit by region and segment"
#| fig-height: 5.5

p_region <- ggplot(region, aes(Region, sales, fill = Segment)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.72) +  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#4b5563") +  scale_y_continuous(labels = currency_short) +  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Sales", fill = "Segment") +  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p_region, tooltip = c("x", "y", "fill"))
```

# Category Performance

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Sub-category sales and profit"
#| fig-height: 6

p_category <- category |>
  mutate(`Sub-Category` = reorder(`Sub-Category`, sales)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    sales,
    `Sub-Category`,
    color = Category,
    size = abs(profit),
    text = paste0(
      "Category: ", Category,
      "<br>Sub-category: ", `Sub-Category`,
      "<br>Sales: ", dollar(sales),
      "<br>Profit: ", dollar(profit),
      "<br>Margin: ", percent(margin, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#6b7280") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = currency_short) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(x = "Sales", y = NULL, color = "Category", size = "|Profit|") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p_category, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Profit by discount band"
#| fig-height: 6

discount_summary <- orders |>
  group_by(discount_band, Category) |>
  summarise(
    sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE),
    profit = sum(Profit, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(discount_band = factor(
    discount_band,
    levels = c("No discount", "Up to 20%", "21% to 40%", "Above 40%")
  ))

p_discount <- ggplot(discount_summary, aes(discount_band, profit, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#4b5563") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = currency_short) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Profit", fill = "Category") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p_discount, tooltip = c("x", "y", "fill"))
```

# Geography

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Top states by sales"
#| fig-height: 5.5

p_top_states <- states |>
  arrange(desc(sales)) |>
  slice_head(n = 12) |>
  mutate(`State/Province` = reorder(`State/Province`, sales)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    sales,
    `State/Province`,
    fill = Region,
    text = paste0(
      "State: ", `State/Province`,
      "<br>Region: ", Region,
      "<br>Sales: ", dollar(sales),
      "<br>Profit: ", dollar(profit),
      "<br>Orders: ", comma(orders)
    )
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = currency_short) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = "Sales", y = NULL, fill = "Region") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p_top_states, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Lowest-profit states"
#| fig-height: 5.5

p_loss_states <- states |>

  mutate(`State/Province` = reorder(`State/Province`, profit)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    profit,
    `State/Province`,
    fill = Region,
    text = paste0(
      "State: ", `State/Province`,
      "<br>Region: ", Region,
      "<br>Sales: ", dollar(sales),

      "<br>Orders: ", comma(orders)
    )
  )) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = "Profit", y = NULL, fill = "Region") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p_loss_states, tooltip = "text")
```

# Products

```{r}
datatable(

    transmute(
      Product = `Product Name`,
      Category,
      `Sub-Category`,
      Sales = dollar(round(sales, 0)),
      Profit = dollar(round(profit, 0)),
      Quantity = comma(quantity)

  options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "tip")
)
```

# Data

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Order-level records"

datatable(
  orders |>
    transmute(
      `Order Date` = order_date,
      `Order ID`,
      Segment,
      Region,
      State = `State/Province`,
      Category,
      `Sub-Category`,
      Sales = round(Sales, 2),
      Profit = round(Profit, 2),
      Discount = percent(Discount, accuracy = 1)
    ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```
